text:
The State of Montana is expected to demand compliance with State
Laws and Regulations, in that the State has jurisdiction over the
surface rights in the Ceded Area. The Crow people hold extensive coal
rights in the Ceded Area but own only a small fraction of the surface.
The surface, which is located outside of the present exterior boundary
of the Crow Reservation, is owned largely by non-Indian residents of Big
Horn County, Montana. Thus the Westmoreland Resources operation, being
on State administered surface lands, must conform with the Montana
Environmental Policy Act and the Montana Strip Mining and Reclamation
Act. Montana law provides for State approval of mining-plans based upon
a study of environmental factors and auditing of active mining operations.
